rules.what: applied before the docs: a page matching `match` (a regex on its repo path) takes `args`

generic_failed.what: a FAILED: line part that only sums up the FAIL lines above it (regexes): left out of a run's items when FAIL lines name the checks

main_tier_drops.what: the flags the main tier takes out of a page's full command (a flag that takes a value takes its value with it): main view only, PERF-PLAN.md 4 item 5

no_look.what: shared files whose change is PROVEN not to change a look (PERF-PLAN.md 2.2 and 4 item 5; D5: tiering yes). A page whose changed inputs are all listed here takes the main tier under --tier auto. Each entry needs its proof (the node test or fingerprint that shows it) and is added only once that proof has run on the Stage 8 tip. Empty: every page takes its full command.

stall.what: a page's stall watchdog in minutes (KRATOR_GPU_STALL_MIN for its job, local or cloud: the harness passes it to the machine) when 25 is too short for a page that is slow but moving; globs on the repo path, the first that matches. Empty: every page takes the harness's 25

long.what: first-run time guesses in seconds (a run's own times replace them: %LOCALAPPDATA%/krator-verify-all/durations.json); longest first

known.what: failures to carry, not fix. `pages`: globs; `match`: regexes (case-insensitive) on a failed item (a FAILED: line's '; ' parts); `gl`: 'software' when the failure is software GL's only; `page_verify`: false for an entry that is a node, Python or Godot test (listed in the report, never matched). `source` D30 is the owner's list (STAGE-8/PLAN.md section 5); HR is HANDOFF-REBUILD.md:120-126's carried list (A step 28), outside D30: the report shows it apart so the owner can rule on it.
